name: Ameritas Dental, Vision & Hearing (individual plans)
notes: Researched from public ameritas.com pages only (no sign-in). The member account (benefits.ameritas.com) lets individual and family policyholders who bought directly pay the premium, update the payment method and billing frequency, manage dependents, update details and terminate coverage. Sign-in uses a user ID and password (the Ameritas Benefits app uses the same user ID and password), modelled as identifier 'username' labelled 'User ID'; 'Forgot password?' sends a verification code by email, or by SMS if a phone was added at registration; 'Unlock account?' unlocks after several failed sign-ins (count not published, family default kept). Login MFA itself is not documented and keeps the family default. Paperless covers claim benefit statements (EOBs), which are not bills, via 'electronic benefit notifications'; it is recorded as supported with that note. Online-access help 800-300-9566 option 3; removing online access is by phone 888-808-5080. Accepted payment methods, AutoPay rules, fees and grace period are not published and keep family defaults. Signed-in nav labels other than Manage premium payments, Go paperless and Profile Details are generic (synthetic). No public nav: see the insurance-template cross-owner request.

registration.note: Register after your coverage effective date.

paperless.note: Paperless replaces mailed claim benefit statements (EOBs) with email notifications.

cancel_service.note: Individual policyholders can terminate coverage in the member account.

help.title: Managing your individual plan online
paragraphs: If you bought an individual or family dental, vision or hearing plan directly from Ameritas, your member account is where you pay your premium, change your payment method or billing frequency, add or remove dependents, update your details and terminate coverage.

The Ameritas Benefits app uses the same user ID and password, but edits to personal information and dependents are made only in the online member account. Allow 24 hours for edits to show on your ID card.
steps: Sign in to your member account.
Make a payment or update your payment method or billing frequency.

help.title: Register for a member account
paragraphs: You can register once your benefits are in effect. A step-by-step registration guide is available, and Ameritas can help if you get stuck.

help.title: Forgot your password or locked out
paragraphs: Choose Forgot password? on the password screen. A verification code is sent to your email, or by text message if you added a phone number when you registered.
After several failed sign-ins your account locks. Choose Unlock account? on the sign-in screen and verify the same way.
To change your password or email, click your name in the top-right corner to open Profile Details. You will need to sign in again afterwards.

help.title: Go paperless for benefit statements
paragraphs: Benefit statements (explanations of benefits) are not bills. You can opt in to email notifications that tell you when claim information is ready in your account instead of receiving paper statements. Sign in and complete the electronic benefit notifications form.

help.title: Get help with online access
paragraphs: If you bought your dental, vision or hearing plan directly from Ameritas and need help with your member account, call 800-300-9566 and choose option 3, or email Ameritas customer service. Members covered through an employer group use 888-808-5080.

To have your online access to dental and vision benefits removed, call 888-808-5080; this cannot be done online. Removing access deletes your username and password, and you can set up a new online profile later by registering again.

extra.intent: You cannot get into your Ameritas member account. Using the Ameritas help pages, find the phone number (and menu option) to call for help with online access. Do not make a payment or change any settings.
Using the Ameritas help pages, find the phone number to call if you want your online member-account access removed. Do not make a payment or change any settings.
